svg.title: Schematic cross-section of the Atlantic Ocean showing AMOC currents at different depths
svg.desc: A vertical slice of the Atlantic from South to North, with arrows showing northward surface flow (Gulf Stream and Ekman), the AMOC maximum at 1000m, southward return flow at intermediate depths (Upper Mid-Ocean), and northward Antarctic Bottom Water below 5000m.
svg.text: Schematic vertical slice of the Atlantic at RAPID latitude (26.5°N) and northward
Arrow thickness ≈ transport magnitude · colour = water temperature
